html:
Here is an image of the California Nebula (in red at the top) and the Pleiades (in blue at the bottom) taken in October.



Technical details:
Date: 2009-10-17
Temperature: 0 to -2 degrees celsius.
Telescope: Canon 50 mm f1.4 lens @ f4.0
Sensor: Canon 40D unfiltered by Jacques Chagnon
Filter: IDAS-LPS (to counter light pollution)
Mount: LX200 10" f 6.3 classic
Guiding: QHY5 and PHD

10 frames of 300 seconds, 10 darks, 10 flats
Calibrated and stacked in Nebulosity
Processing in photoshop
